visualCharacteristics.purpose: A row of short feature or step cards, each with a title and a short description and no image

cells.name: Body
cells.content: optional eyebrow paragraph (e.g. 'Step 1'), title as a heading, description paragraph

cells.name: Image
cells.content: optional image cell (not used on the source page)

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; one cell holding an optional eyebrow paragraph (e.g. 'Step 1'), the title as a heading and a description paragraph; an optional image cell is supported

usage.description: Default: a bordered strip of three feature cards (title + description) separated by vertical dividers. With 'numbered-steps-top-rule': a process sequence where each card has a 'Step N' eyebrow, a title and text, under a thick top rule.

reuseGuidance: Use for text-only feature highlights or numbered process steps. Use the base cards block when cards carry images; use columns for free-form side-by-side content.
